title: Ember's Kiln X EMI
description: EMI integration for Ember's Kiln mod
body:
Simple Fabric mod that provides an [EMI](https://modrinth.com/mod/emi) integration for [Ember's Kiln](https://modrinth.com/mod/embers-kiln).

Only required client-side.
